decks.name: LeetCode #39 - Combination Sum
decks.description: Find all unique combinations that sum to target with unlimited element reuse

cards.question: Combination Sum: Given an array of distinct integers candidates and a target integer target, return a list of all unique combinations of candidates where the chosen numbers sum to target. You may return the combinations in any order. The same number may be chosen from candidates an unlimited number of times. Two combinations are unique if the frequency of at least one of the chosen numbers is different. The test cases are generated such that the number of unique combinations that sum up to target is less than 150 combinations for the given input.

solutions.name: Backtracking
solutions.explanation: Use recursive backtracking to explore all combinations. At each index, make two choices: include current element (can reuse, stay at same index) or skip to next element. Base cases: if total equals target, add current combination copy to result; if index out of bounds or total exceeds target, return. Backtrack by popping element after exploring with it. Explores all possible combinations with repetition allowed. O(2^(t/m)) time where t is target and m is minimum value.

solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given nums=[2,3,6,7], target=7: Start dfs(0,[],0). Include 2: dfs(0,[2],2), include 2 again: dfs(0,[2,2],4), continue until [2,2,3] sums to 7. Backtrack and try other paths. Skip 2, try 3: dfs(1,[],0), include 3: [3,3] exceeds, try [3] then skip to 7: [7] sums to 7. Result: [[2,2,3],[7]].

solutions.name: Backtracking (Optimal)
solutions.explanation: Enhanced backtracking with sorting and loop-based branching. Sort array first to enable early termination. Use for loop instead of binary choice to iterate through remaining candidates. Start loop at current index to allow reuse. Check if adding candidate exceeds target and break early (sorted order guarantees later candidates also exceed). More efficient pruning reduces unnecessary recursive calls. Same time complexity but better practical performance.
